cases.author: CaseR30b
cases.why: rule-text.md:27-33 classifies version, threshold, send, and escalation lines. The prior invocation has one SIGTERM send and one escalation; rule-text.md:84-88 counts both outside the current invocation, so earlier_invocation_send_lines is 2 and current sigterm/sigkill counts are 0. The final version line starts the current plain restart and only threshold lines follow. ActiveState=active selects the active case (rule-text.md:37-40,46-48); ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic=0 makes scope_complete false (rule-text.md:82), so with no current-invocation action the verdict is KILLERS_UNKNOWN and exit 2 (rule-text.md:46-48). No other fields are pinned; the supplied rule text does not decide additional permitted field pins for these inputs.

cases.author: CaseR30d
cases.why: ActiveState=active gives earlyoom.state=active (rule-text.md:37-42). The earlier version and send precede the last version line, which begins the current invocation; the send is therefore one earlier-invocation send, while no send follows the last version line, so current earlyoom.actions.sigterm is 0 and earlyoom.earlier_invocation_send_lines is 1 (rule-text.md:27-35, 84-88). The intervening kill failed line is not a send or escalation counted by that earlier-invocation field (rule-text.md:32-35, 85-86). A zero timestamp leaves scope_complete false (rule-text.md:82-83). The earlier send does not change the verdict for active earlyoom; with incomplete scope and no current-invocation positive evidence, verdict is KILLERS_UNKNOWN, exit 2 (rule-text.md:46-50, 86-88). No other action field is pinned.
